data: AnchorShield allows you to buy protection against stablecoin depegs. When you buy cover, you are acquiring YES Tokens.
data.the-economics#The Economics:
1 YES Token mathematically guarantees a $1.00 USDC payout if the target asset depegs.
If no depeg occurs before Expiry, the YES Token expires worthless ($0.00).
data.how-to-buy-via-the-ui#How to Buy via the:
Navigate to the Hedge Markets tab.
Select an active market (e.g. USDC Depeg).
In the Buy Cover tab, enter how much payout coverage you want (e.g., $1,000).
The system will look at the on-chain Limit Order Book to calculate the premium.
Sign the transaction in Freighter. You will instantly receive YES Tokens in your wallet.
Note: Since you are buying from a limit order book, your transaction may partially fill if there isn't enough underwriting liquidity at your specified price.

data: To protect underwriters from being scammed by a 1-second API glitch, AnchorShield markets use two separate timers.
data.1-sustained-breach-duration#1. Sustained:
When a market is created, it sets a breach duration (e.g., 15 minutes, or 1 hour).
If the oracle price drops below the threshold (e.g., $0.995), the contract's BreachStartedAt stopwatch begins.
If the price recovers to $1.00 before the duration is met, the stopwatch is completely wiped. A depeg must be sustained continuously to trigger a payout.
data.2-market-lifespan-expiry#2. Market Lifes:
The maximum amount of time the market exists. (e.g., 7 Days).
If the Expiry Date is reached and no sustained breach has occurred, the market permanently closes, YES tokens become worthless, and NO tokens can claim the locked collateral.Important: If a sustained breach does happen on Day 1, the market settles immediately. It does not wait for the 7-day expiry!

data: AnchorShield is a parametric insurance protocol built on Stellar (Soroban) designed to protect stablecoin holders and DAO treasuries from depeg events (like USDC or EURC losing their $1.00 peg).
data.why-anchorshield#Why AnchorShield?:
DeFi relies entirely on stablecoins remaining stable. When a stablecoin depegs (even temporarily), cascading liquidations occur. AnchorShield provides a fully decentralized, mathematically guaranteed payout if a depeg happens.
Parametric: Payouts trigger automatically based on on-chain Oracles (Reflector). No claims adjusters. No waiting periods.
Flash-Crash Protected: Features a Sustained Breach Duration timer to ignore 1-second oracle glitches.
Fully Collateralized: Every $1.00 of coverage sold is backed by $1.00 of USDC sitting in the smart contract.
data.developer-first#Developer First: AnchorShield's primary interface is the Soroban smart contract itself. DAOs can programmatically hedge their treasuries via mint_complete_set, and keepers can permissionlessly trigger settlements via try_settle.

data:
Because AnchorShield relies on on-chain limit order books and continuous timer evaluation, it requires external agents to "crank" the smart contract. Anyone can run a Keeper Bot.
Running a keeper helps decentralize the protocol. In future upgrades, Keepers may earn a percentage of the market settlement fee as a bounty.
data.what-keepers-do#What Keepers Do:
A keeper script polls the network and executes two critical functions on every active InsuranceMarket:
fill_orders(env): Matches crossed limit orders on the order book.
try_settle(env): Reads the Reflector Oracle and executes the depeg payout if the breach duration has been met.
data.graceful-failures#Graceful Failures: The try_settle function is designed to fail gracefully. If the asset has not depegged, or if the breach_duration_seconds timer is still ticking, the transaction will simply revert. Your keeper bot will only pay a fraction of a cent in XLM gas fees for the simulation/revert.

data: AnchorShield does not just measure stablecoin market prices. We provide a deep, algorithmically generated Anchor Confidence Ratio (ACR) that acts as an Operational Risk Registry for Stellar Anchors.Our off-chain Watcher node continuously runs forensic analysis on Mainnet data to produce an institutional-grade risk score.
data.live-data-endpoints#Live Data Endpoints: The Oracle tracks three major operational vectors by querying the official Stellar Mainnet and Anchor infrastructure directly.
data.1-hot-wallet-solvency-runway#1. Hot Wall:
An Anchor requires a balance of native XLM in its operational hot wallets to pay for network transaction fees. If this balance hits zero, all fiat-to-crypto off-ramps freeze.
Endpoint: GET https://horizon.stellar.org/accounts/{distributionAccount}
Extraction: We parse the balances array and isolate the asset_type: "native" balance.
Health Grading: The Oracle expects a minimum safe buffer of 5,000 XLM. If the balance is >= 5,000, the Hot Wallet Health score is 100.00% (10,000 bps). If it drops below this, the score degrades linearly (e.g., 25 XLM = 0.50% health).
data.2-on-chain-refunds-the-shadow-default-ra:
To measure failed fiat off-ramps (e.g., KYC failures, frozen bank transfers), we track transactions where an Anchor sends USDC back to a retail user.
Endpoint: GET https://horizon.stellar.org/accounts/{distributionAccount}/payments?order=desc&limit=200
Extraction: We iterate over the last 200 payments. Any payment where the from field matches the Anchor's distribution account and is sending USDC to a user is flagged as an On-Chain Refund.
data.3-sep-24-infrastructure-uptime--latency#:
Endpoint: GET https://{anchor-domain}/.well-known/stellar.toml (To locate the TRANSFER_SERVER)
Endpoint: GET {TRANSFER_SERVER}/info
Extraction: We execute an HTTP ping every 60 seconds. A 200 OK response increases the SEP-24 Success rate. The round-trip time is recorded as the Avg Latency.
data.the-smart-contract-math-acr-computation#:
These data points are pushed on-chain via the update_anchor_metrics function. The Soroban smart contract then ruthlessly calculates the final Composite ACR score (measured from 0 to 10_000 basis points).The mathematical gauntlet:
Base Score: Begins at a perfect 10,000 bps (100.00%).
Success Multiplier: Multiplied by the SEP-24 Success rate. score = (score * success_rate_bps) / 10,000
Latency Penalty: If average latency exceeds 120s, a penalty of -10 bps per second over limit is applied (capped at -2000 bps).
Refund Penalty (Crucial): For every single On-Chain Refund detected in the trailing window, a brutal penalty of -50 bps (-0.5%) is subtracted. score = score - (refundCount * 50)
Hot Wallet Multiplier: The remaining score is multiplied by the Hot Wallet Health percentage. If an Anchor's XLM gas tank is dangerously low (e.g. 1%), their ACR score will practically flatline. score = (score * hot_wallet_health_bps) / 10,000
Historical Volume Bonus: The contract awards a +1 bps bonus for every $10,000 in successful incoming USDC volume detected on the mainnet.
This transparent, ruthless algorithm ensures that Underwriters and Risk Managers can instantly detect an Anchor that is quietly experiencing operational failures before it triggers a massive stablecoin depeg.

AnchorShield does not rely on a centralized backend for core operations. The Smart Contract is the API. Integrators can interact with the protocol directly via Soroban RPC.
All contract addresses and ABIs can be found in the Deployments section.
data.1-market-factory#1. Market Factory: The Factory (market-factory) is the central registry for all deployed AnchorShield markets.
data.get_market#get_market:

Returns: MarketConfig struct

    pub market_id: u32,

data.2-insurance-market#2. Insurance Market: The Insurance Market handles the minting of YES/NO tokens, order book limit orders, and settlement execution. Each market has its own isolated contract address.
data.mint_complete_set#mint_complete_set:
Locks USDC collateral to mint an equivalent amount of YES and NO tokens. This is the entry point for both hedgers and underwriters.Parameters
Name	Type	Description	underwriter	Address	The wallet authorizing the transaction.	amount	i128	The amount of USDC to lock (in stroops, e.g., 10000000 = 1 USDC).	
Authorization Required: The caller must approve the Insurance Market to transfer amount from their USDC balance.

Places a limit order on the on-chain order book to trade YES or NO tokens.Parameters

Permissionless endpoint that checks the Reflector Oracle. If a sustained depeg has occurred (exceeding the breach_duration_seconds), it permanently closes the market and allows YES tokens to be claimed.

data: AnchorShield allows liquidity providers to earn premiums by underwriting the risk of stablecoin depegs. When you underwrite, you are acquiring and holding NO Tokens.
data.the-economics#The Economics:
To underwrite, you must lock $1.00 of USDC to mint 1 YES token and 1 NO token.
You then sell the YES token to a hedger for a premium (e.g., $0.05).
If the market expires safely (no depeg), your NO token can be redeemed for the underlying $1.00 USDC.
Profit: You put in $1.00, got $0.05 instantly, and got your $1.00 back at the end. Total return: +5%.
Risk Warning: If a sustained depeg DOES occur, the NO token expires worthless. You keep the $0.05 premium, but you lose the $1.00 locked principal.
data.idle-yield-defindex#Idle Yield (DeFindex: While your USDC is locked in the smart contract waiting for the market to expire, AnchorShield attempts to route it into yield-generating strategies (like DeFindex / Blend) so you earn native DeFi yield on top of the insurance premiums!
